chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī narrated from al-Ḥasan ibn Mālik, who said:

I wrote to him, meaning ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام, about a man who died and had assigned everything in his lifetime to you, while he had no child. Then afterward he came to have a child, and the amount of his wealth is three thousand dirhams. I have sent to you one thousand dirhams, so if you see fit, may Allah make me your ransom, inform me of your view so that I may act by it.
So he عليه السلام wrote: “Release it to them.”

key_terms.بِأَلْفِ دِرْهَمٍ: with one thousand dirhams sent to the Imam
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةُ آلَافِ دِرْهَمٍ: the stated value of the estate, three thousand dirhams
key_terms.جَعَلَ: assigned or designated legally during his lifetime
key_terms.رَأْيَكَ: your ruling or considered judgment in the matter
key_terms.لَهُمْ: to them, i.e. the entitled survivors or heirs
key_terms.مَبْلَغُ مَالِهِ: the total amount of his property or estate
key_terms.وَلَدًا: a child born or existing later, affecting inheritance rights

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Hādī عليه السلام rule when a man had assigned his property but later left a surviving child?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal inquiry addressed to Imam ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام concerning property previously designated for the Imam, after the owner later had a child. The Imam’s reply orders that the wealth be released to the heirs, indicating the priority of the surviving children’s right in this case. The report is significant for discussions of inheritance, bequests, and financial rights.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5553 - Abdullah ibn Ja'far Al-Himyari narrated from Al-Hasan ibn Malik, who said:

'I wrote to Imam (as) - meaning Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Hadi (as) - about a man who died and had, during his lifetime, given everything he owned to you.
He had no children at the time, but later he had a child. His total wealth amounted to three thousand dirhams, and I have sent you one thousand dirhams.
If you see fit, may Allah (swt) make me your sacrifice, kindly inform me of your opinion so I may act accordingly.'
Imam (as) wrote in response: "Release it to them (the surviving children)."
